Subject: 15% off the Northbay Beacon — 40 hours of runtime, ends Sunday
Preview: Your next trip deserves reliable light. 400 lumens, 40-hour runtime, 95g.
Body: You know what it's like to reach camp after dark, or wake up at 3 a.m. for an alpine start. The light on your head needs to work — simply and without fuss.

The Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05) puts out 400 lumens and runs for 40 hours on a charge. At 95 grams, it won't add meaningful weight to your kit. It charges via USB-C, so one cable covers it alongside most of your other gear.

It's a headlamp built for trail, camp, and predawn moves — not for technical cave diving or extreme submersion. It does what a solid headlamp should do, consistently, over a long charge.

Through Sunday, take 15% off the Northbay Beacon. No code needed — discount applies at checkout.
